_note: Blocks new ENTRY signals (not exits, not existing positions) when the broader market benchmark isn't itself in an uptrend. Disabled by default - run scripts/find_index_instrument.py, add the chosen index's instrument_key to config/universe.json's 'instruments' map (never to a tradeable 'list'), fetch its history with scripts/fetch_history.py --symbols <benchmark_symbol>, then flip enabled to true here.
